scope: Development validation, 2026-09-24. Separate runs; not a reproduction of every original article configuration. Memory/startup Docker and Jerboa execute sequentially with matching settings. Network/disk are completion and integrity regressions, without matching Docker performance controls.
limitations: TCP_INFO total_retrans is not implemented; reported zero is not evidence of zero retransmissions.
UDP offered load is 1 Gbit/s; loss is reported, not treated as a successful bandwidth target.
macOS default companion quota is 64 MiB/s plus 100000 packets/s; about 521 Mbit/s UDP payload at 1420-byte datagrams. Small below-quota losses are measured and are not explained by quota.
ARM64 writable mapped pages are conservatively dirty; extra writeback is possible.
Reboot checks use fsync and orderly shutdown; whole-journal power-loss atomicity is not established.

followup.status: completed: demonstrated network stalls and TFS shrink/regrow corrected; measured performance limits retained

tfs.note: Expanded dirty/writeback, simultaneous truncation, MAP_SHARED, boundary and error tests passed on macOS ARM64 and Linux x86_64 at 128 MiB, including reboot. Full-filesystem dense and sparse shrink/regrow passed on both architectures including reboot.

sparse_control.reason: Old partial-page clearing allocated storage for a hole on a full filesystem.

network_failed_control.cause: VirtIO polling TX EVENT_IDX interrupt threshold was not rearmed while queued messages remained; rearmed each batch with a completion-race check.

vmm_metrics.scope: Sampled VMM counters, not all guest/switch drop locations.

linux.sequential_1g_reboot_enospc: runs/disk-reserve (rechecked by disk-delivery.log with final kernel)

cleanup.preserved: Logs, results, hashes, regression disks and original packages/volumes retained; deleted-file SHA256 manifests in isolated Linux tree and local evidence copy.

historical_sections: Top-level network and disk preserve the prior campaign; followup contains current corrected measurements and final build identities.
